acceptance.py.one_line: DynamoAcceptance.accept now requires a keyword acting_principal_id (refused ACTING_PRINCIPAL_REQUIRED when absent) and writes it on every NEW accepted request record, so the record the function persists changes shape; a prior record is returned as stored.

submission_service.py.one_line: SubmissionService.submit passes the verified principal's id to accept as acting_principal_id; it moves with acceptance.py, one without the other raises TypeError on every new submission.

served.py.one_line: The svc-custody-statement subject's allow-list gains the operation analysis-request-read, so that subject on an event naming it passes the boundary's NOT_AUTHORIZED gate (this function has no handler for it and answers UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION).

loaders.py.one_line: load_directory refuses a latest.json pointer with no usable key as FirmArtifactIncomplete (NOT_READY) where the live code raised KeyError or TypeError or returned; the other hunk is a generated-header comment.

ids.py.one_line: The account id projection treats a seam-mapped value of none, nan, null or empty (any case) as unmapped and returns the raw id, where the live code minted an id from the string None.

data/custodian_key_seam.json.one_line: The bundled custodian-key seam the id projection reads at runtime loses 826 entries whose mapped value was the string None, so those accounts project raw instead of to a minted id.

durable_job.py.one_line: DynamoGenerationStore.get_state now returns i3_sent_at when present and a new mark_i3_sent records the I3 send once, by a conditional update on the job row; it changes the job row the resident writes and the state it reads.

resident_worker.py.one_line: Adds the I3 analysis_ready send after READY with the i3_sent_at marker and a redelivery resend, the Opal producer branch for an allow-listed principal (producer_for, run_opal), the reopen binding for an Opal report and poll_package_once for the commentary_ready queue; the resident writes different rows and sends different messages.

resident_main.py.one_line: The resident loop accepts a runtime with package_queue_url and packager and then also polls the commentary_ready queue each iteration, and its once-mode exit code now follows both polls; a runtime of that shape was refused on live.

owned_requests.py.one_line: The owned-request history reads the firm's accepted requests whole (bounded 2000) newest-first, pages by position, and every history row states client_id and client_claim with an unreadable_rows count; the answer the history route gives changes shape and order.

repository.py.one_line: Named service subjects (svc-commentary, svc-irpt-packager) are admitted by name, family and tenant for artifact reads and the one writer's put, ReportRepository refuses a service subject, and ArtifactAlreadyWritten is added; the access decision for those principals changes.

retention.py.one_line: RetentionPolicy._allow admits a named service subject for a retention-liveness read and for reserve of its registered family inside its own tenant; the retention decision for those principals changes.

recipe.py.one_line: Comment-only change to the READ_BACK_POLLS note: ast.dump of the live and built modules is identical, so no statement, constant or signature differs.

firm_registry.json.one_line: Only the _generated header string differs (the registry digest named in the generation mark); the parsed rest is equal, no packaged module reads _generated outside opal_naming's generator, and the built tree run with the live file gives identical results on every probe.

lib/opal_naming.py.one_line: The module the function calls for reporting_policy, reporting_destination, lookup, address and load_registry gains optional registry files and about 500 added lines of generator, census and naming code; the registry it loads and the policy digests it returns are what the function binds records to.

org/standards/NAMING_SCHEMA.json.one_line: opal_naming.address reads this schema at runtime (replaced by invalid JSON, every holdings address raises), so the schema moves with the code that reads it (five commits since the live blob: kinds user and group, the fifo suffix, the fourth verdict, the cadence rules, the naming section render).

infra/logic/registry/exemptions.json.one_line: Parsed by opal_naming.load_registry on every call (invalid JSON makes the composition raise); adds scoped exemption rows for two box identities, which the registry validation reads.

infra/logic/registry/reporting_policies..one_line: The research policy irpt-ycdgen-research-v1 is widened from cottonwood to cottonwood, 49financial and inflection (its policy_sha256 moves) and a new ACTIVE policy irpt-anlreq-x10-v1 (ANALYSIS_COMMENTARY) is added; destinations the function can write change.

infra/logic/registry/resources.json.one_line: Parsed by opal_naming.load_registry on every call; one LAMBDA_LAYER row (openpyxl-layer) is removed from the resource-to-system table the name validation reads.

infra/logic/registry/scopes.json.one_line: Read by lookup and by publication's printed firm names; adds a MASTER row 4698 for inflection, tenant pages, masters and restricted_prefix_hosts, so lookup('4698') resolves and the scope rows the function reads change.

infra/logic/registry/systems.json.one_line: Parsed by opal_naming.load_registry on every call; adds vendor and sprint rows and reclassifies service words, which the name and address validation reads.

contracts/AnalysisReport.schema.json.one_line: Adds the retained_ref property (the server-issued report receipt) to the schema the function packages; the packaged schema directory is digested into ingestion_revision, which every accepted request records.

contracts/ExportReceipt.schema.json.one_line: Revision 1.2: adds covered_account_ids to facts and makes it required; part of the packaged schema directory whose digest is the ingestion_revision recorded on every accepted request.

contracts/HoldingsSnapshot.schema.json.one_line: The asset_class enum loses the value multi_asset at five nodes, so a snapshot node carrying it validates on live and is invalid on built; part of the packaged schema directory behind ingestion_revision.

contracts/OwnedAnalysisRequest.schema.js.one_line: Adds the persist_inputs property (artifact id, composition sha256, retention policy, report index); part of the packaged schema directory behind ingestion_revision.

contracts/OwnedAnalysisRequestHistory.sc.one_line: History rows now require client_id and client_claim and the document requires unreadable_rows, so the legacy history shape is invalid and the new one valid; part of the packaged schema directory behind ingestion_revision.
